quarterly_data.quarter: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries press release: MHI Accelerates AI Infrastructure Commercialization with (10-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: MHI's 10MW-class centrifugal chiller JHT-Z270I obtained ETL-Listing and AHRI certification, completing key milestones for commercial deployment in the United States and starting market introduction for next-generation AI data center applications. The chiller is the core cooling component of MHI's Modular Chiller Plant (centrifugal chiller, pumps, heat exchangers and controls in a pre-engineered platform with hybrid free-cooling and closed-loop modes), part of its Power, Cooling and Energy Management portfolio for AI infrastructure; MHI Group holds approximately 60% of Japan's centrifugal chiller market (FY 2025 domestic shipments).
quarterly_data.figure: 10MW-class chiller; approximately 60% share of Japan centrifugal chiller market
